description: This file contains functions for fusing convolutional and linear modules with batch normalization modules in PyTorch, including evaluation and weight fusion functions.

methods.name: fuse_conv_bn_eval
methods.description: Fuses a convolutional layer and a BatchNorm layer into a single convolutional layer, assuming both are in eval mode.

methods.name: fuse_conv_bn_weights
methods.description: Fuses the weights and biases of a convolutional layer and a BatchNorm layer into new convolutional weights and biases.

methods.name: fuse_linear_bn_eval
methods.description: Fuses a linear layer and a BatchNorm layer into a single linear layer, assuming both are in eval mode.

methods.name: fuse_linear_bn_weights
methods.description: Fuses the weights and biases of a linear layer and a BatchNorm layer into new linear weights and biases.
